title: Couch-Torrence conformal inversion, supersymmetry and conserved charges for D3-branes
summary: An asymptotically flat spacetime in $D=4$ can be mapped via Couch-Torrence conformal inversion to the geometry around an extremal non-expanding and non-rotating horizon. At the linearized level, an infinite tower of conserved Newman-Penrose charges can be found at null-infinity, while infinitely many Aretakis charges are conserved in the near-horizon. Couch-Torrence inversion allows one to establish a matching between the two sets of asymptotic charges.
